title: Zoho Books Automation: Recurring Invoices, Payment Reminders & Workflow Rules (2026)
description:
Automate billing in Zoho Books with three settings: recurring invoices (Sales › Recurring Invoices › New: Customer Name, Profile Name, Repeat Every; child invoices saved as draft or sent right away), automatic payment reminders (Settings › Reminders › Invoices: three automated reminders before or after the due date, expected payment date reminders, Stop Reminders), and workflow rules (Settings › Workflow Rules › New Workflow Rule: module, event-based or date-based trigger, criteria, immediate or time-based actions like email alerts, field updates, webhooks and functions). Plus three mistakes to avoid and a checklist.

0:00 Zoho Books on autopilot in 30 seconds
